# forumulate_space_types (Data Source)

The space-type vocabulary (`GET /space-types`): for each type what a piece and a container are called, its tabs and its layout presets. Read it instead of hard-coding which layouts a type accepts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "forumulate_space_types" "all" {}

output "space_types" {
  value = data.forumulate_space_types.all.names
}

# What layouts a blog accepts.
output "blog_presets" {
  value = [for t in data.forumulate_space_types.all.types : t.presets if t.type == "BLOG"][0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `space-types`.
- `names` (List of String) The type codes, such as `DOCS`, `FORUM`, `BLOG`.
- `types` (Attributes List) Every space type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--types))

<a id="nestedatt--types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `types`

Read-Only:

- `backing` (String) What a piece is stored as: `page`, `topic`, `event` or `incident`.
- `container_names` (List of String) What a container is called (`collection`, `category`).
- `default_slug` (String) The slug a space of this type gets by default.
- `description` (String) What it is.
- `forced_visibility` (String) `PRIVATE` for a type that is always private.
- `name` (String) Its display name.
- `piece_names` (List of String) What a piece is called (`page`, `article`, `topic`).
- `piece_presets` (List of String) The layouts `piece_preset` accepts.
- `presets` (List of String) The layouts `preset` accepts for this type.
- `purpose` (String) What it is for.
- `recommended_preset` (String) The layout used when none is chosen.
- `tabs` (List of String) The console tabs the type has.
- `type` (String) The type code.
